property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any address _owner, calling setOwner(_owner) leaves C.owner equal to the provided _owner (reference); the mutant that sets owner = address(0) breaks this because after setOwner it will instead be address(0) for some fuzzed _owner values.
change_summary: Invert assignment to set owner to address(0) when setOwner is called, clearing ownership instead of setting to the provided address.
